description: Three-level PKI: root CA -> intermediate CA -> leaf. For chain-verification and OCSP tests. No certs committed yet — generate in order below.

certificates.name: root_ca
certificates.purpose: Self-signed root CA; issues intermediate_ca and the root CRL
certificates.subject: /CN=Test-Root-CA/O=Eclipse

certificates.name: ocsp_signer
certificates.purpose: OCSP signing certificate issued by root_ca; used to sign OCSP responses
certificates.subject: /CN=Test-OCSP-Signer/O=Eclipse
certificates._note: ext_file adds extendedKeyUsage = OCSPSigning — required for OCSP response signing

certificates.name: intermediate_ca
certificates.purpose: Intermediate CA issued by root_ca; issues leaf and the intermediate CRL
certificates.subject: /CN=Test-Intermediate-CA/O=Eclipse

certificates.name: leaf
certificates.purpose: End-entity cert issued by intermediate_ca; subject of OCSP request/response
certificates.subject: /CN=Test-Leaf/O=Eclipse
